name: fxr_pt_18_lucca
doc: The playthrough's leg 18_lucca (tools/playthrough/route.txt, the cartridge's own pad, graded leg by leg against the port by tools/playthrough.py): out of the queen's chamber to the east tower (1D4), down its floors (Left+Up into each stair box at x 112) to the hall; two tiles down the passage the hall's obj17 sees the lead at y 11 (loc[10] = the lead's tile row) and Lucca runs in ("Crono!"), the scene at 06C, back in the hall: Lucca joins (storyline 12)
